format: 90-second silent, captioned walkthrough of executed notebook plots; not a real-time screen recording

scenes.caption:
Go services can summarize locally. Python can read the same sketch bytes.
This notebook merges two service shards within each of two windows.

The notebook checks byte-for-byte round trips and rejects incompatible profiles.
It then compares merged distinct estimates with known synthetic counts.

HLL++ gives a distinct-count estimate, not a list of identities.
Its characterization envelope is not a per-estimate confidence interval.

Weighted frequent-items returns token-volume intervals for pseudonymous keys.
Green crosses are exact synthetic values used to check those intervals.

Each interval is scaled to its own upper estimate to show its width.
This axis is not the key's share of all token consumption.

Hashes stay linkable under one secret. The notebook cannot name the user.
Start with python -m pip install llm-sketchkit and the Go-to-Python example.
